name: Italian
description: Italian cuisine is known for its regional diversity, rich taste, and iconic dishes like pasta, pizza, and risotto. It emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients.

name: Mexican
description: Mexican cuisine features vibrant, flavorful dishes that blend indigenous and Spanish influences, including tacos, enchiladas, and mole.

name: Japanese
description: Japanese cuisine focuses on seasonal ingredients and simple preparation, offering dishes like sushi, ramen, and tempura.

name: Indian
description: Indian cuisine is characterized by its diverse use of spices and herbs, creating flavorful dishes such as curry, biryani, and naan.

name: French
description: French cuisine is renowned for its precision and artistry, offering a range of dishes from pastries like croissants to fine dining specialties.
